provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2025-26 College Football Playoff semifinals (Miami beat Ole Miss 31-27 at the Fiesta Bowl, Indiana beat Oregon 56-22 at the Peach Bowl) and National Championship (Indiana beat Miami 27-21) as played. Each event is one round, so one game for each team. The field is every quarterback, running back, receiver and tight end of the teams who had a pass, carry or catch in the 2025 regular season (conference championships included) or in the game, positions and birth countries from ESPN's athlete records; ranking is the player's regular-season Redzone total, from ESPN's box scores of each team's regular-season games. Each playoff box score (passing, rushing and receiving yards and touchdowns, receptions) is from ESPN, cross-checked player by player against CBS Sports, which agree on every stat. A player with no catch, carry or pass has no line; Oregon cornerback D'Angelo Ponds, who had a line in his semifinal, is not in the field, as the field is offensive players only.
